I'll think this through like the farmer I am.

---

My land is 9.5 mu. I keep about 3 mu for cotton and 6.5 mu for the wheat-maize rotation. Cotton price has been so-so these years, but I've grown it my whole life and I know what to do. The wheat and maize double crop is safer — grain is always grain.

For wheat, I plant in early October after the maize comes off. I use an improved variety — I buy seed from the town shop, whatever they tell me most people are planting, usually Jimai or Shimai type. Before sowing I spread compound fertilizer (复合肥 15-15-15), about one bag and a bit per mu — that's around 50-55 jin, so roughly 25 kg per mu. Then at green-up in spring (返青) I top-dress with urea, about half a bag per mu, so 20 jin or so — that gives maybe 10 kg urea, and urea is near half nitrogen so about 4-5 kg N more. My total N comes to around 16 kg per mu. I water the wheat at sowing, then before winter (冬灌), then at jointing, then at heading — four times with the well. I spray two times, once for aphids and once for the rust/powdery mildew when I see it. Plough before sowing so the stubble goes under. I expect about 450 kg per mu — same as last year.

For maize, I plant right after the wheat harvest in mid-June, no-tillage, direct seeding with a hybrid seed — Zhengdan or Xianyu type, whatever the dealer has. Base fertilizer I put compound at sowing, about 25 kg per mu, then top-dress urea at the big trumpet stage (大喇叭口), another 15 kg urea per mu. Total N about 17-18 kg per mu. Maize here I water once or twice — once after sowing if it's dry, once at tasseling. Spray once for corn borer (玉米螟). Expect 550 kg per mu.

For cotton, I plant early May. I use improved Bt cotton seed — you have to, or the bollworm eats everything. Before planting I put one bag compound per mu plus some manure I've saved. Later I top-dress urea at flowering, half a bag. Total N around 14 kg. Cotton I water 2-3 times depending on rain. Cotton needs more spraying — 4 or 5 times for aphids, spider mites, and bollworm even with Bt. Plough before planting. I expect 250 kg seed cotton per mu — cotton yields are not what they used to be.

I do what worked last year. Fertilizer prices went up but you can't save there — if the crop is hungry you lose more than you save. I'd rather put a little extra than come up short.
